question: Which runs so far were affected by the unapproved executor transport (ClaudeJSONTransport: claude -p with tools disabled), and which are unaffected?
basis: User correction 2026-09-24: the executor must reach the model through claude-code-openai-wrapper used like an HTTP API (AGENTS §0.2.14).
Builder/evolver, judge and constructor/reviewer are Claude Code native agents by the user's §0.2.13 decision; the correction does not concern them.

Model-purity scan D:/mrhbench-local-pilot/proxy/claude_era_model_scan.json over all 116 Claude-era transcripts before the wrapper work: every builder, judge, constructor, reviewer and executor call was answered by claude-opus-5-5; the only silent fallback (to claude-opus-4-8) was probe 232, whose response the transport rejected.

affected_executor_runs.what: executor-transport probes on the wrong path
affected_executor_runs.carry_over: Two platform findings from 231 and 247/248 were re-run on the wrapper (331, 332) and hold: 'reasoning' schema fields are refused (reasoning_extraction); property keys must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,64}$. Interface v3 disclosure and key aliasing therefore stay valid.

affected_executor_runs.what: integration v1 (frozen H0 v1, interface v2)
affected_executor_runs.status: not a measurement: already platform-attributed (reasoning-field refusals) and additionally on the unapproved executor transport

affected_executor_runs.what: integration v2 on frozen H0 v3 + IDEA reruns
affected_executor_runs.status: executor outputs produced on the unapproved transport; the per-task scores (WC 3.75, IDEA 3.8, LIT 1.75, WE 3.0, EXP stage_failed) must NOT be used as H0 baselines or evolution signal and must be re-run through the wrapper
still_valid_from_these_runs: judge behaviour evidence (the judge correctly graded the artifacts it was given; v3.2-v3.4 schema/tile/downscale fixes and the trajectory review in claude_integration_v2_review_v1.json)

H0 v3 defect findings that come from reading the H0's own requests (asset path never passed to the executor; only the last 4 observations kept; resources never shown) — these are harness properties independent of transport
platform bugs found and fixed (typed broker errors, collection behaviour, image downscaling by the same CLI)

affected_executor_runs.what: halted new-paper integration (Diffusion EXP stage, 7 executor calls)

unaffected.what: Codex era (gpt-5.6-sol; executor via codex exec, judge/builder native Codex)
unaffected.status: separate historical configuration; not touched by this correction, but AGENTS already records that the codex exec executor was not a bare-API/HTTP proxy either; keep as historical development evidence only, never mixed with Claude results

unaffected.what: Claude native judge probes and judge re-validation on synthetic fixtures (no executor involved)
Claude Code native builder H0 v1 and v3 (zero scientific tasks) plus their fake-client independent reviews
unaffected.status: valid; H0 v3 remains the frozen development H0

unaffected.what: Claude constructor/reviewer material construction, resume review and repair round
all zero-call work: source adjudications (Gaussian, Diffusion), LIT private labels, runtime verification, package compilation, platform code and tests

correct_path_runs.what: wrapper setup, conformance (official openai SDK), upstream before/after comparison, debug captures, finding re-checks, transport smoke
notes: 312 and 327 are the upstream wrapper's own startup 'Hello' calls, recorded after the fact
313-316 predate the no-fallback switches and are superseded; 321/324 were safeguard refusals before the ResultError mapping fix

next: Re-run the five-type integration of frozen H0 v3 through the wrapper (OpenAICompatTransport, config/role_transport_claude_v2.json); only those results can serve as development measurements of the executor path.
